name: Clipboard History
description: Text you copied recently, ready to paste again. Copies marked secret by password managers are skipped

preferences.name: limit
preferences.title: Keep up to
preferences.description: Older items are forgotten. Pinned items never are.

preferences.name: ignored
preferences.title: Ignore copies from
preferences.description: App IDs or names, separated by commas. KeePassXC and other apps that mark copies as secret are always skipped.
